Product Manager Intern
details: Enhanced Incentive & Growth System: Increased DAUs from 1.7M to 2.1M by refining growth strategies and building sustainable tools for the Shopee video platform, including task posting, mentorship tasks, and stage feedback for video-watching activities.
Improved User Retention: Extended average retention time by 1.2 minutes through the design and implementation of incentive-based video engagement mechanisms.

Boosted User Engagement: Implemented themed pages aligned with local festivals and events, adding 32,000 Daily Active Users and improving video reach conversion by 5% via new shortcuts and green channels.

entries.title: Product Manager Intern
details: UX and Feature Optimization: Led enhancements to clip search, streaming, and display, increasing library views by 23%; designed innovative editing tools, boosting user engagement metrics significantly (cover views +13%, sharing +17%).
Automation and AI Integration: Partnered with image recognition teams to automate video frame analysis and content selection, improving both accuracy and efficiency in user interactions.

Product Metrics and Impact: Implemented iterative feedback mechanisms, elevating retention rates from 30% to 35%, supporting a user base of 3.5 million daily active users through refined video/photo management features.
Patent: Invented and patented a core intelligent recommendation feature for the Kuaiying App's cover templates (Patent No. 2021KT2414).

entries.title: AI Product Manager Intern
details: SaaS Platform Development: Played a key role in launching outbound call automation products; authored PRDs for critical platform functions (Account Management, Enterprise Certification, Enterprise Management, Automatic Blacklisting), managed UI reviews and iterative feature updates.
Admin Platform Improvement: Drafted targeted PRDs addressing Task Optimization and Enterprise Audit, streamlining internal processes and administrative efficiency.
Competitive Intelligence and Analytics: Authored strategic competitive product analysis reports (Spici, Baidu Cloud, Ali Cloud); identified critical indicators for the Account Asset Center.
Data-Driven Project Delivery: Delivered interactive accuracy evaluation on speech recognition models (n=1,000); launched data-driven reports, enhancing product transparency and reliability.

entries.title: Product Manager Intern
details: Product Ownership & Strategy: Directed over 70% of the feature set for an AI-driven educational tool targeting middle and high school students, managing 12+ PRDs across core learning features such as listening, reading, writing correction, global audio, and parental control.

User Research & Market Insight: Executed large-scale user studies (survey n=3,000, 20 in-depth interviews, quantitative test n=105), combined with competitive analyses (e.g., iFlytek, XiaoAi, Weixin Reading), to shape detailed personas, market segmentation, and actionable gamification proposals.
Feature Development & Optimization: Authored 11 PRDs (6 new features, 5 optimizations), enhancing Oxford Dictionary integration, UI/UX, and engagement-driven functionality.
